outcome: CAM use as a therapy by practitioners
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 394 healthy pregnant women after 34 weeks of gestation in Japan.
finding: Approximately 20% of Japanese pregnant women received CAM as therapy by practitioners, associated with planned childbirth at midwifery birth centers and pregnancy complications, while almost 90% used CAM as self-care, associated with being older, having a higher educational level, and being primiparous.
mod_finding: Factors associated with CAM use as a therapy included midwifery birth centers for planned childbirth settings, suggesting an indirect link to birth preferences, but not directly to mode of birth.
